details: The brush handler calls renderAll() directly on every mousemove with no RAF coalescing or debounce, triggering a full canvas redraw of all 4 panels on each event (~60fps); the canvas-based rendering (no SVG DOM mutations) mitigates severity somewhat but the un-throttled redraw is still a clear Update Storm violation. No infinite loop risk exists since brushes only write to shared state and trigger canvas repaints, not other brush events; no transition conflicts apply since the visualization is fully canvas-based with no D3 transitions.
